subject: Runtime proxy subprocessor addition — evidence, export paths & rollout timeline
messages:
-----Message 1 (2026-04-15 09:12 PDT)-----
From: Alex Garcia <alex@edgelayer.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TransitBound runtime proxy onboarding — subprocessor notice and roster

Hi Marcus,

Following our tech kick-off last week, EdgeLayer is scheduled to push TransitBound (runtime-sidecar proxy v1.2) into Redwood's US runtime pool on 2026-05-04. TransitBound will handle a small amount of telemetry aggregation and routing for edge agents. Per our DPA we wanted to pre-notify you and attach the updated roster + egress map for your review.

Quick facts: 
- Purpose: telemetry relay and protocol translation for edge telemetry (no model content storage).
- Data types: request metadata, anonymized telemetry, connection metrics.
- Retention: ephemeral (max 72 hours), configurable via API.
- Proposed region: US-only (primary: us-west-2), with a fallback node in us-east-1.

Attachments: transitbound_subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (roster + contact), egress_map_runtime-proxy.pdf (export and endpoint mapping).

We appreciate any evidence packets or checklist items you need from us for SOC/DPA compliance. Happy to set up a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex Garcia
Account PM, EdgeLayer Solutions
alex@edgelayer.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

-----Message 2 (2026-04-15 11:03 PDT)-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex@redgelayer.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TransitBound runtime proxy onboarding — subprocessor notice and roster

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. A few immediate asks from our side to speed review:

1) Can you confirm whether TransitBound will perform any token or header transformations that could result in user-identifiable fields being logged upstream? If yes, we need the exact fields and retention controls.
2) Provide an export-path diagram showing where telemetry leaves EdgeLayer boundaries (already looked at the PDF but want an annotated path to Azure/GCP/S3 if any).
3) Confirmation of onshore fallback — you note us-east-1 as fallback; we need that explicitly recorded in the roster.
4) A point of contact for emergency data access requests and a phone number for escalation (we need 24/7 contact during the canary window).

Operational note: we plan a limited canary for 48 hours on 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-06 targeting 1% of edge traffic; if evidence checks pass we'll widen rollout. Please deliver the requested evidence by 2026-04-22 EOD so legal and security have time to review.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

-----Message 3 (2026-04-16 08:27 PDT)-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Alex Garcia <alex@redgelayer.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TransitBound runtime proxy onboarding — subprocessor notice and roster

Alex / Marcus — legal/security here. A few items required before we can sign off on the DPA addendum and allow the canary:

- Evidence: please provide a short attestation (PDF) covering encryption-at-rest (keys + KMS provider), TLS mutual-auth details for runtime connections, and whether any PII is present in telemetry samples. If you do not store any payloads, state that explicitly.
- Export assurances: confirm no export outside the US (i.e., no analytics batching to EU/APAC) and provide the async export blacklist if used.
- Key custody: if EdgeLayer uses a third-party KMS/HSM, identify provider and jurisdiction (we require US/EU-based KMS for any customer-seeded keys).
- Data subject access: confirm how Redwoods' legal team can request an evidence snapshot (format, retention, turnaround SLA).
- DocuSign: we'll need a DPA addendum signed that includes the processing activities and the onshore fallback clause. Please send a completed addendum via DocuSign when ready.

Timeouts/Deadlines: we need all evidence by 2026-04-22 so security can complete a 48-hour review before your proposed canary. If items are missing we will delay.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

-----Message 4 (2026-04-18 10:12 PDT)-----
From: Alex Garcia <alex@redgelayer.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TransitBound runtime proxy onboarding — subprocessor notice and roster

Kimberly — thanks, details below and attached. Apologies for the weekend email but wanted to hit your deadline.

- Token/header handling: TransitBound does not persist full request payloads. It logs only connection metadata (IP hashes, connection duration, header keys only for routing). We do not capture Authorization header values. I attach a redacted telemetry sample and a short attestation PDF.
- Export path: TransitBound routes telemetry to EdgeLayer US analytics, which is hosted in us-west-2 (primary) and us-east-1 (fallback). No automated exports to EU/APAC. The attached export map shows endpoints and S3 buckets (all US).
- KMS: we use AWS KMS (us-west-2) for server-side encryption; no third-party HSM in the chain.
- Data subject access: we support evidence snapshots delivered as gzipped JSON with a 72-hour retention window; SLA for a legal evidence pull is 7 business days.
- DocuSign: uploaded the DPA addendum and prefilled; link: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-id/TransitBound-DPA-Addendum 

Attachments: transitbound_subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (updated), transitbound_attestation.pdf, transitbound_telemetry_sample_redacted.json, egress_map_runtime-proxy.pdf

Please confirm receipt; if that matches your needs we can proceed with the 48-hour canary as proposed.

Best,
Alex Garcia
EdgeLayer Solutions

-----Message 5 (2026-04-20 17:42 PDT)-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex@redgelayer.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TransitBound runtime proxy onboarding — subprocessor notice and roster

Alex — got everything, thank you. Kimberly + Security: attestation and export map look good on a first pass. Two quick follow-ups before we greenlight the canary: 

- Ben please add TransitBound to the subprocessor inventory and set the region flag to us-only in the console.
- Alex / EdgeLayer: please add an emergency escalation phone for the canary window (24/7) — a routed escalation number is sufficient.
- Legal: we'll sign the DocuSign addendum once the emergency contact is added to the roster.

Can we lock the 48-hour canary for 2026-05-04 00:00 UTC (start) — Marcus to approve the rollout and Ben to monitor token-level latency/cost during canary. If no regressions, plan for 2-week progressive ramp.

Marcus Lin
Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
